caption:
Your rule breaches. Every pending order cancels and positions square off.

KaatDo runs a server-side kill switch across six brokers: Fyers, Upstox, Zerodha, Angel One, Dhan and Groww, built on official trade APIs.

You configure six rules: max_daily_loss, profit_target, max_trades, kill_time, kill_days, and kill_dates. On breach, KaatDo cancels every pending order, squares off every position at market, keeps the account locked until close, and re-fires if trading activity reappears.

kaatdo.com

KaatDo is a risk-management technology tool, not investment advice, and is not registered with SEBI. Broker API execution is never guaranteed.
